# CORRECTION — Behbahani & Lam (2011), strongly regular graphs with non-trivial automorphisms

<!-- source: correction record; see research/sources/behbahani-lam-2011-srg-nontrivial-automorphisms.full.md -->

**This summary supersedes an earlier auto-generated digest that described a
wrong download (a condensed-matter physics paper, arXiv:1103.1430). That
content has been removed from the library; nothing graph-theoretic should be
attributed to arXiv:1103.1430.**

## What this source is

- Behbahani, Majid; Lam, Clement. "Strongly regular graphs with non-trivial
  automorphisms." Discrete Math. 311 (2011) 2-3, 132-144. DOI
  10.1016/j.disc.2010.10.005. This run did NOT obtain the full text (paywalled,
  no open arXiv version); its identity and contribution are recorded from the
  papers that cite it, which ARE in the library.

## What it establishes (as confirmed by the citing primary sources in-library)

1. Introduced the **orbit-matrix** technique for SRGs with a prime-order
   automorphism group, and an algorithm to reconstruct the SRG from an orbit
   matrix. This is the methodological foundation the later (99,14,1,2)
   automorphism constraints build on.
2. It is the first in the line ("Behbahani–Lam, Crnković–Maksimović,
   Cesarz–Woldar") studying whether a putative Conway 99-graph can carry
   non-trivial automorphisms.

## Status

Full text **not in library** (paywalled). The automorphism results directly
relevant to the 99-graph are covered in-library by Cesarz–Woldar 2025 and
Crnković–Maksimović 2020 — use those for the actual constraints.
